title: FIL Pixels To Frame
text: Convert pixel stream from FPGA-in-the-loop to frame-based video, 6 inputs, 2 outputs, {Video format} sets Dimensions of active regions of a video frame; {Number of components} sets the number of values used to represent each, {Number of pixels} and {Input vector format} sets the size of the vector used to communicate with the FPGA subsystem. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: hStartIn
ports.summary: First pixel in horizontal line of frame vector

ports.name: hEndIn
ports.summary: Last pixel in horizontal line of frame vector

ports.name: vStartIn
ports.summary: First pixel in first (top) line of frame vector

ports.name: vEndIn
ports.summary: Last pixel in last (bottom) line of frame vector

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Indicates when output frame is ready scalar

params.name: Number of components
params.values: Number of values used to represent each pixel 1 (default) | 2 | 3 | 4

params.name: Number of pixels
params.values: Number of pixels in each column of input matrix 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | 8

params.name: Input vector format
params.values: Size of the vector used to communicate with the FPGA subsystem Frame (default) | Line | Pixel

params.name: Video format
params.values: Dimensions of active regions of a video frame 1080p (default) | 240p | 480p | 480pH | 576p | 720p | 768p | 1024p | 1200p | 2KCinema | 4KUHDTV | 8KUHDTV | Custom
